en.name: Mengpo
en.ability: Each night*, you may choose an alive player. They choose either: 1) their ability becomes "You have no ability." or 2) they die & keep their ability until dusk.

revisions.v1: Each night*, choose a player: if they are alive, they must choose to lose their ability or die and keep their ability until dusk.

zh.name: 孟婆
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你可以选择一名存活玩家，他要二选一：1）能力描述修改为“你没有能力。”；2）死亡并保留能力直到下个黄昏。
